<code>gpt-6.2-astra</code> or <code>gpt-6.2-sol</code> in the Responses API. Both models support Ultrafast at launch.</p><p>In standard, single-agent mode, you can change reasoning effort or switch from plain text to structured output between replies. Append a <code>configuration_update</code> item before the next user message and keep the request-level settings unchanged. <a href="/api/docs/guides/keep-prefix-unchanged">Keeping earlier input intact</a> helps preserve reasoning across turns and keeps that input eligible for prompt caching.</p><span id="api-pricing"></span><p>If your project uses data residency, both models support US and EU regions for Standard, Fast, and Batch processing. Ultrafast supports US data residency only. See the <a href="/api/docs/guides/latest-model?model=gpt-6.2-astra">GPT-6.2 migration guide</a> and <a href="/api/docs/pricing#text-tokens">API pricing by service tier</a>.</p></div></div></div><div <li><strong>Diagnose a bug across services.</strong> Give Astra the failing workflow and ask it to trace the cause, implement a fix, and run the affected tests.</li>
<li><strong>Build a deck from a report.</strong> Give Astra the report and your slide template. Ask it to present the findings in your team’s layout and writing style.</li>
<li><strong>Investigate a research question.</strong> Give Astra the sources and ask it to compare their findings and identify where the evidence disagrees.</li>
</ul></div><div><h3 id="gpt-62-sol" class="group flex items-center gap-1 mt-7 mb-2 scroll-mt-[110px]"><span class="min-w-0">GPT-6.2 Sol</span><button type="button" class="shrink-0 self-center <li><strong>Revise code after review.</strong> Give Sol the reviewer’s feedback and ask it to update the implementation and run the relevant tests.</li>
<li><strong>Turn meeting notes into a project brief.</strong> Ask Sol to pull together decisions, next steps, and open questions from your notes.</li>
